text:
leah: Heads-up — embedding-fingerprint de-dupe is tagging ~1.1k items from the latest crawl as near-duplicates. At the same time we're running a q4_8 quant run on the new-small-2b candidate in staging and we need a stable golden set for eval. Do we auto-prune or hold for manual curation? :thinking:
omar: How many of those flagged items overlap with our eval promptset top-50? If it's mostly tail we can be aggressive with pruning and save labeling budget.
leah: Quick numbers: 1,124 flagged total, 87 overlap with current eval promptset top-50. Sample ids: 
```
["c4321","b992","e7754","f112","g009"]
```
maria: Can we cross-check embedding-fingerprint score against token n-gram overlap? Last time the fingerprint threshold alone produced false positives when score < 0.98 but ngram overlap was low.
devin: Proposal: two-stage filter — keep auto-prune for fingerprint < 0.935 AND Jaccard token overlap < 0.4. Anything that hits eval-set (those 87) goes to human-in-loop. That keeps the golden stable for quant comparisons.
omar: For the quant eval, are we comparing q4_8 against fp16 baseline? Also we should freeze the promptset for at least 48h before running the metric sweep to avoid metric drift.
leah: Yes, fp16 baseline. My proposal: freeze current golden for 72h and create a snapshot called "golden-staging-195432" for the quant run. Manual triage for the 87 overlapping items (assign to labelers).
label-bot: 87 tasks created and assigned to the golden-labeling queue. ETA 24-36h. :white_check_mark:
maria: Also add a small adversarial cohort: last q4_8 run showed hallucination uptick on the legal-asks subset. Add ~120 prompts focused on long-context legal questions + ambiguous references.
devin: I'll add the hallucination cohort and the hidden-regression checks. Plan: run both micro-evals and full-route evals; if relative BLEU/improved-quality metrics drop >2% on the cohort we mark it as a regression and trigger route auto-fallback to fp16 for that model.
leah: Timeline: Devin to push filters + cohort by EOD, labelers to finish triage in 36h, then I'll snapshot the golden after label sign-off and kick off the quant run. Any objections?
omar: No objections. :thumbsup: 
label-bot: Noted — will ping when all labels are complete.
leah: Thanks everyone — will post snapshot link and the quant run dashboard once started. :eyes:
